output.narrative:
Revenue experienced a decrease of -191.49 (-5.57%), dropping from 3438.53 to 3247.04. This movement was primarily driven by requests, which contributed -127.14 to the revenue drop, alongside a decline in fill_rate contributing -71.48. 

A drill-down into requests showed that the movement was broad-based and proportional across all checked dimensions and segments rather than being concentrated in a single localized cause. For instance, within the ad_format dimension, the banner segment showed a lift of 0.98, demonstrating that its decline followed the broad uniform trend. 

Several segments were checked and ruled out due to lack of disproportionate impact, such as the video ad_format segment, which had an explanatory power of 0.128 and a lift of 0.98. Similarly, within regions, MEA was ruled out with a lift of 0.98 and an explanatory power of 0.101.
